page.overview:
Who is Baumar?

When was a child, he almost got lost up in the . While a saved him, has trouble recall his name. was the shield surfer, and he claims that surfing down the mountain with a child on his back was difficult.

On the way to the , mentally prepares himself for , and he becomes annoyed if interrupts him. The legendary , , supposedly had all of her routes memorized. There is a rumor has heard that is waiting on the for a worthy opponent.

If he is caught in the rain, will be disappointed disappointed that he can not shield surf. While it is storming or snowing, wonders if professional shield surfers head out in this type of weather, confessing he would break his neck if he wiped out.

Occasionally, will give a tip. For example, depending on the type of used, one's surfing will be different. He knows of a that is supposed to be good for , which is the , but he can not remember what it is called. Additionally, he has heard of the within , which is supposed to be durable.
